model_scope: Deterministic two-degree mean-field synergistic SIS dynamics, degrees 20 and 5, proportions 1/5 and 4/5, equal reciprocal stub weights; reversible degree assortativity -1<=r<1, recovery rate 1, infection strength lambda>0, synergy alpha>=0.
scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic identities and strict polynomial sign certificates are displayed with a reproducible SymPy checker. Primary and relevant related literature were compared at statement level. An incompletely accessible related 2023 paper and possible unindexed equivalent results leave a publication-priority risk; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Local center-manifold and local endemic-branch results only. No global bistability or hysteresis classification, no finite-population stochastic conclusion, and no extension to the reducible r=1 endpoint.
title: Exact assortativity threshold and cubic critical decay for a two-degree synergistic SIS system
